earnings.title: Colgate-Palmolive Announces 3rd Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Net sales increased 4.6%; Organic sales* increased 3.6%, including a 0.2% negative impact from lower private label pet food sales
GAAP EPS increased 3% to $0.94; Base Business EPS* increased 7% to $0.97
outlook: The Company now expects net sales to be up 4% to 5% (versus 2% to 6% previously), including a low-single-digit positive impact from foreign exchange.
The Company now expects organic sales growth to be broadly in line with its nine-month performance (versus 1% to 4% previously).

items.heading: We face risks associated with significant international operations, including exposure to foreign currency fluctuations.
Significant competition in our industry could adversely affect our business.
The rapidly changing retail landscape and changing consumer preferences may adversely affect our business.
The growth of our business depends on the successful identification, development and launch of innovative new products.
Damage to our reputation could have an adverse effect on our business.
Our success depends upon our ability to recruit, attract and retain key employees and the succession of senior management.
